en.description:
CK-4 10W-40 is a fully synthetic diesel engine oil in the SAE 10W-40 viscosity grade, formulated to API CK-4. API defines CK-4 for high-speed four-stroke diesel engines designed to meet 2017 model-year on-highway and Tier 4 non-road emission standards, and for earlier diesel engines.

The specification table publishes typical values from the product data sheet, each with its ASTM method: kinematic viscosity at 40 °C and 100 °C, cold-cranking viscosity, base number, Noack volatility and foaming tendency, plus viscosity after shear and copper corrosion. Check those values and the API category against the engine manufacturer's requirement before ordering.

applications.title: High-speed four-stroke diesel engines
applications.description: Engines whose manufacturer specifies API CK-4, or an earlier API diesel category that CK-4 is intended to cover.

applications.title: On-highway and non-road equipment
applications.description: API scopes CK-4 to engines built for on-highway and Tier 4 non-road emission standards, which covers trucks, buses and off-road machinery whose manuals call for it.

applications.title: Operating climate suited to SAE 10W-40
applications.description: Cold-start performance is rated at -25 °C under SAE J300; choose this grade where ambient temperatures and the manufacturer's viscosity chart allow 10W-40.

features.title: Inside the SAE J300 limits for 10W-40
features.description: Kinematic viscosity at 100 °C is 15.1 cSt, within the SAE J300 band for grade 40 (12.5 to below 16.3 cSt). Cold-cranking viscosity is 5,650 cP at -25 °C, under the 7,000 cP maximum that SAE J300 sets for 10W.

features.title: Base number 12.3 mg KOH/g
features.description: The total base number (TBN, ASTM D2896) of 12.3 mg KOH/g is the oil's alkaline reserve for neutralising acidic combustion by-products between drains.

features.title: Viscosity index 173, Noack 6.2 %wt
features.description: A viscosity index of 173 (ASTM D2270), Noack evaporation loss of 6.2 %wt (ASTM D5800) and a pour point of -36 °C (ASTM D97) are published as typical values.

faq.question: Can CK-4 10W-40 be used in an engine that calls for API CJ-4?
faq.answer: API describes CK-4 as covering engines built for 2017 emission standards and earlier diesel engines, so it is normally the forward-compatible choice. Always follow the engine manufacturer's recommendation, including any OEM approval it requires.

faq.question: Is CK-4 the same as FA-4?
faq.answer: No. API defines FA-4 as a separate category of XW-30 oils for selected 2017 engines and states that it is not interchangeable with CK-4 or earlier categories.

fa.description:
CK-4 10W-40 روغن موتور دیزلی تمام‌سنتتیک با درجهٔ گرانروی SAE 10W-40 و مطابق ردهٔ API CK-4 است. API ردهٔ CK-4 را برای موتورهای دیزلی چهارزمانهٔ پرسرعتی تعریف کرده که برای استانداردهای آلایندگی جاده‌ای مدل ۲۰۱۷ و استاندارد Tier 4 تجهیزات غیرجاده‌ای طراحی شده‌اند؛ این رده موتورهای دیزلی قدیمی‌تر را هم پوشش می‌دهد.

جدول مشخصات، مقادیر معمول برگهٔ داده‌های محصول را همراه با روش آزمون ASTM هر کدام منتشر می‌کند: ویسکوزیتهٔ سینماتیک در ۴۰ و ۱۰۰ درجهٔ سلسیوس، ویسکوزیتهٔ استارت سرد، عدد قلیایی، تبخیرپذیری نوآک و تمایل به کف‌کردن، به‌علاوهٔ ویسکوزیته پس از برش و خوردگی مس. پیش از سفارش، این مقادیر و ردهٔ API را با الزام سازندهٔ موتور تطبیق دهید.

applications.description: عملکرد استارت سرد طبق SAE J300 در دمای منفی ۲۵ درجهٔ سلسیوس سنجیده می‌شود؛ این گرید را جایی انتخاب کنید که دمای محیط و جدول گرانروی سازنده 10W-40 را مجاز بداند.

features.title: درون محدوده‌های SAE J300 برای 10W-40
features.description: ویسکوزیتهٔ سینماتیک در ۱۰۰ درجهٔ سلسیوس ۱۵٫۱ سانتی‌استوکس است و در بازهٔ SAE J300 برای درجهٔ 40 (از ۱۲٫۵ تا کمتر از ۱۶٫۳ سانتی‌استوکس) قرار می‌گیرد. ویسکوزیتهٔ استارت سرد در دمای منفی ۲۵ درجهٔ سلسیوس ۵۶۵۰ سانتی‌پواز است؛ کمتر از حداکثر ۷۰۰۰ سانتی‌پوازی که SAE J300 برای 10W تعیین کرده است.

features.title: عدد قلیایی ۱۲٫۳ میلی‌گرم KOH بر گرم
features.description: عدد قلیایی کل (TBN، روش ASTM D2896) برابر ۱۲٫۳ میلی‌گرم KOH بر گرم است؛ ذخیرهٔ قلیایی روغن برای خنثی‌کردن محصولات اسیدی احتراق در فاصلهٔ دو تعویض.

features.title: شاخص گرانروی ۱۷۳ و تبخیر نوآک ۶٫۲ درصد وزنی
features.description: شاخص گرانروی ۱۷۳ (ASTM D2270)، اتلاف تبخیری نوآک ۶٫۲ درصد وزنی (ASTM D5800) و نقطهٔ ریزش منفی ۳۶ درجهٔ سلسیوس (ASTM D97) به‌عنوان مقادیر معمول منتشر شده‌اند.

faq.question: آیا CK-4 10W-40 را می‌توان در موتوری که API CJ-4 خواسته است به کار برد؟
faq.answer: API ردهٔ CK-4 را برای موتورهای طراحی‌شده برای استانداردهای ۲۰۱۷ و نیز موتورهای دیزلی قدیمی‌تر تعریف کرده است؛ بنابراین معمولاً جایگزین سازگار رو به جلو است. همواره توصیهٔ سازندهٔ موتور، از جمله تأییدیه‌های OEM موردنیاز آن، را مبنا قرار دهید.

faq.question: آیا CK-4 همان FA-4 است؟
faq.answer: خیر. API ردهٔ FA-4 را رده‌ای جداگانه برای روغن‌های XW-30 در برخی موتورهای ۲۰۱۷ تعریف کرده و تصریح می‌کند که با CK-4 یا رده‌های قدیمی‌تر قابل جایگزینی نیست.

faq.question: Which CI-4 viscosity grade should I choose?

en.description:
CF-4 15W-40 is a heavy-duty diesel engine oil in the SAE 15W-40 viscosity grade, formulated to API CF-4. API now lists CF-4 as obsolete: it is not suitable for most diesel automotive engines built after 2009, and remains relevant to older engines whose manuals specify it.

The specification table publishes typical values from the product data sheet, each with its ASTM method: kinematic viscosity at 40 °C and 100 °C, cold-cranking viscosity, base number, Noack volatility and foaming tendency, plus viscosity after shear and copper corrosion. Check those values and the API category against the engine manufacturer's requirement before ordering.

applications.title: Older diesel engines specified for CF-4
applications.description: Engines and fleets whose service manuals name API CF-4, typically equipment built before the later diesel categories were introduced.

applications.title: Operating climate suited to SAE 15W-40
applications.description: Cold-start performance is rated at -20 °C under SAE J300; choose this grade where ambient temperatures and the manufacturer's viscosity chart allow 15W-40.

features.title: Inside the SAE J300 limits for 15W-40
features.description: Kinematic viscosity at 100 °C is 15.6 cSt, within the SAE J300 band for grade 40 (12.5 to below 16.3 cSt). Cold-cranking viscosity is 4,583 cP at -20 °C, under the 7,000 cP maximum that SAE J300 sets for 15W.

features.title: Base number 11 mg KOH/g
features.description: The total base number (TBN, ASTM D2896) of 11 mg KOH/g is the oil's alkaline reserve for neutralising acidic combustion by-products between drains.

features.title: Viscosity index 134, Noack 4.3 %wt
features.description: A viscosity index of 134 (ASTM D2270), Noack evaporation loss of 4.3 %wt (ASTM D5800) and a pour point of -27 °C (ASTM D97) are published as typical values.

faq.question: Is CF-4 15W-40 suitable for modern diesel engines?
faq.answer: API lists CF-4 as obsolete and not suitable for most diesel automotive engines built after 2009. For newer engines, choose the category the manual specifies, such as CI-4, CJ-4 or CK-4.

CJ4 Grade is a multigrade diesel engine oil for heavy-duty diesel engines, blended from fully synthetic base oil and an advanced additive package. Available grades: CJ4 10W40, CJ4 15W40. API defines CJ-4 for high-speed four-stroke diesel engines designed to meet 2010 model-year on-highway and Tier 4 non-road emission standards, and for earlier diesel engines.

en.description:
SN 5W-30 is a synthetic-based gasoline engine oil for passenger cars in the SAE 5W-30 viscosity grade, formulated to API SN. API lists SN as a current category for gasoline automotive engines of model year 2020 and older.

The specification table publishes typical values with their ASTM methods — kinematic viscosity, cold-cranking viscosity, Noack volatility, base number, shear stability, foaming tendency and copper corrosion — so the oil can be checked against the vehicle handbook before purchase.

applications.title: Gasoline passenger-car engines
applications.description: Vehicles whose handbook calls for API SN — per API, gasoline engines of model year 2020 and older — or an earlier API gasoline category.

applications.title: Climates suited to SAE 5W-30
applications.description: The 5W winter rating is tested at -30 °C under SAE J300; use this grade where the handbook's viscosity chart allows 5W-30 for local temperatures.

features.title: Inside the SAE J300 limits for 5W-30
features.description: Kinematic viscosity at 100 °C is 10.8 cSt, within the SAE J300 band for grade 30 (9.3 to below 12.5 cSt). Cold-cranking viscosity is 6,580 cP at -30 °C, under the 6,600 cP maximum that SAE J300 sets for 5W.

features.title: Viscosity index 174, Noack 8.3 %wt
features.description: A viscosity index of 174 (ASTM D2270), Noack evaporation loss of 8.3 %wt (ASTM D5800) and a pour point of -39 °C (ASTM D97) are published as typical values.

features.title: Base number 6 mg KOH/g
features.description: The total base number (TBN, ASTM D2896) of 6 mg KOH/g is the oil's alkaline reserve for neutralising acidic combustion by-products between drains.

faq.question: Can SN 5W-30 be used where the handbook asks for API SP?
faq.answer: API SP is a later category, introduced in 2020 with added protection against low-speed pre-ignition and timing-chain wear. Where a handbook specifies SP, use an SP oil; SN is intended for 2020 and older engines.

The specification table publishes typical values with their ASTM methods — kinematic viscosity, cold-cranking viscosity, Noack volatility, base number, shear stability, foaming tendency and copper corrosion — so the oil can be checked against the vehicle handbook before purchase.

applications.description: Vehicles whose handbook calls for API SN — per API, gasoline engines of model year 2020 and older — or an earlier API gasoline category.

faq.question: Can SN 5W-40 be used where the handbook asks for API SP?

en.description:
SN Grade is a multigrade gasoline engine oil made from synthetic base oil and additives for modern gasoline cars, offered in four grades from 0W20 to 10W40. Available grades: SN 0W20, SN 5W30, SN 5W40, SN 10W40. API lists SN as a current category for gasoline automotive engines of model year 2020 and older.

Each grade is listed separately in the specification table with its viscosity at 100 °C, viscosity index, flash point, pour point, density and base number, so grades can be compared directly before ordering.

applications.title: Modern gasoline cars
applications.description: Vehicles whose handbook calls for API SN — per API, gasoline engines of model year 2020 and older.

features.title: Published values by grade
features.description: SN 0W20: KV100 8 cSt, VI 160, TBN 9.5, pour point -42 °C; SN 5W30: KV100 11.7 cSt, VI 155, TBN 9.5, pour point -36 °C; SN 5W40: KV100 14.5 cSt, VI 165, TBN 9.5, pour point -39 °C; SN 10W40: KV100 15 cSt, VI 150, TBN 9.5, pour point -33 °C.

features.title: Choice of viscosity grades
features.description: 4 grades in one product line, so a fleet can standardise on one API level across different climates or engine requirements.

faq.question: Which grade should I choose?
faq.answer: Follow the SAE grade in your vehicle handbook. Under SAE J300 a lower W number is rated for colder starts (0W at −35 °C, 5W at −30 °C, 10W at −25 °C, 20W at −15 °C); the second number is the viscosity class at operating temperature.

faq.question: Is this the same product as the motorcycle SN Grade?
faq.answer: No. This is the passenger-car SN Grade; the motorcycle SN Grade is a separate fully synthetic product for four-stroke motorcycles.

en.description:
locomotive Oil is a zinc-free engine oil for locomotive diesel engines, made from base oils and additives formulated without zinc. It is offered as SAE 40 and SAE 15w-40.

Zinc-free formulation matters where the engine builder restricts zinc in the lubricant — some locomotive engines use bearing or component materials for which zinc-containing oils are not recommended. Both grades publish a TBN of 16 mg KOH/g in the specification table.

applications.title: Locomotive diesel engines
applications.description: Railway diesel engines whose manufacturer calls for a zinc-free lubricant.

applications.title: Monograde or multigrade service
applications.description: SAE 40 for engines specified for a monograde oil; SAE 15w-40 where the manual allows a multigrade.

features.title: Zinc-free formulation
features.description: Formulated without zinc, as stated in the product's source documentation.

features.title: Published values by grade
features.description: SAE 15w-40: KV100 15.5 cSt, VI 125, TBN 16, pour point -30 °C; SAE 40: KV100 15 cSt, VI 95, TBN 16, pour point -18 °C.

faq.question: Why does a locomotive oil need to be zinc-free?
faq.answer: Some locomotive engine builders restrict zinc because of the materials used in their engines. Always confirm the engine builder's lubricant requirement before changing oil.

fa.description:
locomotive Oil روغن موتور بدون روی (Zinc-free) برای موتورهای دیزلی لوکوموتیو است که از روغن‌های پایه و افزودنی‌های فاقد روی تهیه می‌شود. این محصول در دو گرید SAE 40 و SAE 15w-40 عرضه می‌شود.

فرمولاسیون بدون روی در موتورهایی اهمیت دارد که سازنده‌شان وجود روی در روغن را محدود کرده است؛ برخی موتورهای لوکوموتیو از مواد یاتاقان یا قطعاتی استفاده می‌کنند که روغن‌های حاوی روی برایشان توصیه نمی‌شود. TBN منتشرشده برای هر دو گرید ۱۶ میلی‌گرم KOH بر گرم است.

en.description:
Racing Grade is a racing engine oil made from synthetic base oil with a special formulation, intended for race cars and severe driving. It is offered in 10W60 and 5W60.

The 60 hot grade is the heaviest class in SAE J300, chosen for engines that run at sustained high temperature and load. Published values include viscosity indices of 185 and 183; the kinematic viscosity entries for these grades are still under technical review and are not yet shown.

faq.question: Can I use a 60 grade in a normal road car?
faq.answer: Only if the vehicle handbook allows it. Most modern road engines specify lower-viscosity grades, and a heavier oil than specified can slow oil flow at start-up.

en.description:
Extreme Pressure (EP) is an extreme-pressure (EP) industrial gear oil for enclosed industrial gearing. It is offered in ISO VG 68, ISO VG 100, ISO VG 150, ISO VG 220, ISO VG 320, ISO VG 460, ISO VG 680, ISO VG 1000.

The specification table lists, for each grade, kinematic viscosity at 40 °C and 100 °C, viscosity index, pour point, flash point and four-ball weld load, each with its test method. Share operating conditions with our technical team to confirm the grade before supply.

applications.title: Enclosed industrial gearboxes
applications.description: Spur, helical and bevel gear units where the manufacturer specifies an EP gear oil in one of the ISO VG grades offered.

features.title: Published values
features.description: ISO VG 68: KV40 69 cSt, KV100 8.7 cSt, VI 102, pour point -21 °C; ISO VG 100: KV40 99 cSt, KV100 10.6 cSt, VI 101, pour point -18 °C; ISO VG 150: KV40 151 cSt, KV100 14.9 cSt, VI 99, pour point -15 °C; ISO VG 220: KV40 224 cSt, KV100 17.8 cSt, VI 98, pour point -15 °C; ISO VG 320: KV40 321 cSt, KV100 23.6 cSt, VI 96, pour point -12 °C; ISO VG 460: KV40 465 cSt, KV100 31.5 cSt, VI 96, pour point -12 °C; ISO VG 680: KV40 684 cSt, KV100 42.5 cSt, VI 95, pour point -12 °C; ISO VG 1000: KV40 1030 cSt, KV100 55.5 cSt, VI 97, pour point -9 °C.

features.title: Viscosity grades checked against ISO 3448
features.description: Published kinematic viscosity at 40 °C sits inside the ISO 3448 tolerance (mid-point ±10 %) for ISO VG 68 (69 cSt); ISO VG 100 (99 cSt); ISO VG 150 (151 cSt); ISO VG 220 (224 cSt); ISO VG 320 (321 cSt); ISO VG 460 (465 cSt); ISO VG 680 (684 cSt); ISO VG 1000 (1030 cSt).

features.title: Extended test set
features.description: Besides viscosity, the published data includes four-ball weld load, flash point (COC) and foaming tendency.

faq.question: How do I choose the grade?
faq.answer: Start from the equipment manufacturer's viscosity recommendation at operating temperature. The ISO VG number is the mid-point kinematic viscosity at 40 °C (ISO 3448), and each grade's published values are listed separately.

en.description:
hydraulic oil- HL Grade is a hydraulic oil based on mineral base oil and additives for hydraulic control systems and power transmission, also suitable for circulating systems. Grades: HL 22, HL 32, HL 46, HL 68, HL 150. In the ISO 6743-4 family, HL denotes a refined base oil with rust and oxidation inhibitors (ASTM D6158).

The specification table lists each grade separately, with the test method for every value, so grades can be compared directly before ordering.

applications.title: Hydraulic control and power transmission
applications.description: Systems whose manufacturer specifies an ISO 6743-4 HL fluid.

applications.title: Circulating systems
applications.description: Circulation lubrication where an HL-type oil of the right viscosity is specified.

features.title: Published values by grade
features.description: HL 22: KV40 22 cSt, KV100 4 cSt, VI 100, pour point -30 °C, flash point 200 °C; HL 32: KV40 32 cSt, KV100 5.5 cSt, VI 100, pour point -30 °C, flash point 210 °C; HL 46: KV40 46 cSt, KV100 6.8 cSt, VI 100, pour point -27 °C, flash point 220 °C; HL 68: KV40 68 cSt, KV100 9 cSt, VI 106, pour point -24 °C, flash point 220 °C; HL 150: KV40 150 cSt, KV100 16 cSt, VI 110, pour point -18 °C, flash point 225 °C.

faq.question: What is the difference between HL and HH?
faq.answer: Under ISO 6743-4 (as summarised in ASTM D6158), HH is a refined base oil without rust, oxidation or anti-wear additives, while HL adds rust and oxidation inhibitors. Use the category your equipment manufacturer specifies.

en.description:
GL-5 75W-80 is a gear oil in the SAE 75W-80 viscosity grade, catalogued under API GL-5 and listed for manual gearboxes. API 1560 describes GL-5 as intended for gears, particularly hypoid gears, in axles operating under combinations of high-speed shock load and low-speed, high-torque conditions.

Published typical values are a kinematic viscosity of 8.2 cSt at 100 °C, a viscosity index of 153 and a pour point of -33 °C, together with flash point, appearance and copper corrosion (ASTM D130) in the specification table.

applications.title: Axles and final drives
applications.description: Differentials and axles, including hypoid gear sets, where the vehicle manufacturer specifies API GL-5.

applications.title: Manual gearboxes that specify GL-5
applications.description: Manual transmissions whose manual calls for a GL-5 gear oil in this viscosity grade. Some manual gearboxes specify GL-4 instead; check before use.

features.title: SAE 75W-80 gear oil
features.description: Viscosity at 100 °C of 8.2 cSt and viscosity index 153 (ASTM D445 / D2270).

features.title: Low-temperature flow
features.description: Published pour point of -33 °C (ASTM D97).

features.title: Copper corrosion reported
features.description: Copper-strip corrosion at 100 °C (ASTM D130) is part of the published test set.

faq.question: Can a GL-5 oil be used where GL-4 is specified?
faq.answer: Not automatically. API 1560 treats GL-4 and GL-5 as different designations, and some manual gearboxes are designed for GL-4 only. Follow the gearbox manufacturer's specification.

seo.metaTitle: GL-5 75W-80 Gear Oil (API GL-5, SAE 75W-80) | SAM Group
seo.metaDescription: GL-5 75W-80 gear oil, SAE 75W-80, API GL-5 for axles and manual gearboxes. KV100 8.2 cSt, VI 153, pour point -33 °C. Request a quote.

fa.description:
GL-5 75W-80 روغن دنده با درجهٔ گرانروی SAE 75W-80، در ردهٔ API GL-5 و معرفی‌شده برای گیربکس‌های دستی است. استاندارد API 1560 ردهٔ GL-5 را برای چرخ‌دنده‌ها، به‌ویژه دنده‌های هیپوئید در اکسل‌هایی تعریف می‌کند که ترکیبی از بار ضربه‌ای در سرعت بالا و گشتاور زیاد در سرعت پایین را تحمل می‌کنند.

مقادیر معمول منتشرشده عبارت‌اند از ویسکوزیتهٔ سینماتیک ۸٫۲ سانتی‌استوکس در ۱۰۰ درجهٔ سلسیوس، شاخص گرانروی ۱۵۳ و نقطهٔ ریزش منفی ۳۳ درجهٔ سلسیوس؛ نقطهٔ اشتعال، ظاهر و خوردگی مس (ASTM D130) نیز در جدول مشخصات آمده است.

applications.title: اکسل‌ها و دیفرانسیل‌ها
applications.description: دیفرانسیل‌ها و اکسل‌ها، از جمله دنده‌های هیپوئید، در مواردی که سازندهٔ خودرو API GL-5 را تعیین کرده است.

applications.title: گیربکس‌های دستی با الزام GL-5
applications.description: گیربکس‌های دستی که دفترچه‌شان روغن GL-5 در همین گرید را خواسته است. برخی گیربکس‌های دستی GL-4 را تعیین می‌کنند؛ پیش از استفاده بررسی کنید.

features.title: روغن دنده SAE 75W-80
features.description: ویسکوزیته در ۱۰۰ درجهٔ سلسیوس ۸٫۲ سانتی‌استوکس و شاخص گرانروی ۱۵۳ (ASTM D445 و D2270).

features.title: جریان‌پذیری در دمای پایین
features.description: نقطهٔ ریزش منتشرشده منفی ۳۳ درجهٔ سلسیوس (ASTM D97).

features.title: گزارش خوردگی مس
features.description: خوردگی نوار مسی در ۱۰۰ درجهٔ سلسیوس (ASTM D130) جزو آزمون‌های منتشرشده است.

faq.question: آیا روغن GL-5 را می‌توان جای GL-4 به کار برد؟
faq.answer: نه به‌طور خودکار. API 1560 این دو را رده‌های متفاوتی می‌داند و برخی گیربکس‌های دستی فقط برای GL-4 طراحی شده‌اند. دستور سازندهٔ گیربکس را مبنا قرار دهید.

en.description:
GL-5 85W-140 is a gear oil in the SAE 85W-140 viscosity grade, catalogued under API GL-5 and listed for manual gearboxes. API 1560 describes GL-5 as intended for gears, particularly hypoid gears, in axles operating under combinations of high-speed shock load and low-speed, high-torque conditions.

Published typical values are a kinematic viscosity of 28.3 cSt at 100 °C, a viscosity index of 147 and a pour point of -21 °C, together with flash point, appearance and copper corrosion (ASTM D130) in the specification table.

applications.title: Axles and final drives
applications.description: Differentials and axles, including hypoid gear sets, where the vehicle manufacturer specifies API GL-5.

applications.title: Manual gearboxes that specify GL-5
applications.description: Manual transmissions whose manual calls for a GL-5 gear oil in this viscosity grade. Some manual gearboxes specify GL-4 instead; check before use.

features.title: SAE 85W-140 gear oil
features.description: Viscosity at 100 °C of 28.3 cSt and viscosity index 147 (ASTM D445 / D2270).

features.title: Low-temperature flow
features.description: Published pour point of -21 °C (ASTM D97).

features.title: Copper corrosion reported
features.description: Copper-strip corrosion at 100 °C (ASTM D130) is part of the published test set.

faq.question: Can a GL-5 oil be used where GL-4 is specified?
faq.answer: Not automatically. API 1560 treats GL-4 and GL-5 as different designations, and some manual gearboxes are designed for GL-4 only. Follow the gearbox manufacturer's specification.

en.description:
ISO VG 32 is a hydraulic oil in the ISO VG 32 viscosity grade. Under ISO 3448, ISO VG 32 means a kinematic viscosity of 28.8 to 35.2 cSt at 40 °C; the published value for this product is 32 cSt.

The specification table also lists viscosity at 100 °C (5 cSt), viscosity index 100, pour point -9 °C, flash point 198 °C and density, each with its test method.

applications.title: Industrial and mobile hydraulic systems
applications.description: Pumps and circuits whose manufacturer specifies ISO VG 32 at the system's operating temperature.

features.title: ISO 3448 grade check
features.description: KV40 of 32 cSt is inside the ISO VG 32 band (28.8–35.2 cSt).

features.title: Published values
features.description: KV100 5 cSt, VI 100, pour point -9 °C, flash point 198 °C.

faq.question: Which ISO VG grade does my system need?
faq.answer: Use the viscosity range in the pump manufacturer's documentation at your operating temperature. Lower grades suit colder conditions or high-speed pumps; higher grades suit higher temperatures and loads.

Mineral-Based is a mineral-based antifreeze / anti-boil engine coolant for vehicle cooling systems. It is diluted with water according to the vehicle manufacturer's instructions.

Published values are a density of 1134 kg/m³ at 15 °C and a reserve alkalinity of 18 mL of 0.100 N HCl (ASTM D1121); the pH of a 33 % by volume solution in water (ASTM D1287) is also listed. Reserve alkalinity measures the coolant's capacity to neutralise acids that form in service.
